name: The Westin Fort Lauderdale Beach Resort
positioning: An oceanfront Fort Lauderdale Beach resort with a skywalk to the sand, views of the Atlantic and the Intracoastal Waterway, and a Heavenly Spa
best_for: Beach lovers who want direct skywalk access to Fort Lauderdale Beach
Cruise passengers sailing from Port Everglades

facts.text: Many rooms and suites offer ocean views.
The Royal Palm Presidential Suite is a top-floor ocean-view corner suite with a whirlpool.
Heavenly Spa has eight treatment rooms including couples' suites, an infrared sauna and a co-ed relaxation lounge.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open 24/7.
Outdoor wellness programs include yoga on the terrace, HIIT workouts and oceanside cycling.
On the beach, guests can enjoy beach chairs and non-motorized water sports.
Lona Cocina & Tequileria is a Mexican restaurant led by chef Pablo Salas.
Las Olas Boulevard, with a square mile of shopping and dining, is a quick walk from the hotel along the promenade.
Guests can tour the 'Venice of America' aboard the Water Taxi of Fort Lauderdale.
Up to two pets are welcome per room.
The hotel is less than five miles from the Port Everglades cruise port.

highlights.text: A skywalk connects the pool deck directly to the beach.
The resort has 360-degree views of the Intracoastal Waterway and the Atlantic Ocean.
The 8,200-square-foot Heavenly Spa offers treatments inspired by tropical destinations such as Japan, Zanzibar, Fiji, Brazil, Costa Rica and Iceland.
The oceanfront pool deck has an outdoor pool and Waves, the poolside bar and grill.

considerations.text: The beach is across the street, reached by the hotel's skywalk.
WhataHotel notes a busy resort atmosphere during peak season.
